sql.project.getAllForCompanyProcess: select project.id, company_process.company_id, company_process.process_id, project.customer_id, project.project_name as name from flow.company_process inner join flow.project on company_process.id = project.company_process_id where company_process.company_id = :companyId and company_process.process_id = :processId;
sql.project.get: select project.id, company_process.company_id, company_process.process_id, project.customer_id, project.project_name as name from flow.company_process inner join flow.project on company_process.id = project.company_process_id and project.id = :projectId where company_process.company_id = :companyId and company_process.process_id = :processId;
sql.project.getAllForCustomer: select project.id, company_process.company_id, company_process.process_id, project.customer_id, project.project_name as name from flow.project inner join flow.company_process on company_process.id = project.company_process_id and company_process.company_id = :companyId where project.customer_id = :customerId;
sql.project.getFieldsByProjectId: select cf.id as custom_field_id, pcv.id as project_custom_value_id, cf.field_name, cfga.field_order, cdt.company_data_type, pcv.date_value, pcv.text_value, pcv.timestamp_value, pcv.boolean_value from flow.project p inner join flow.project_custom_value pcv on pcv.project_id = p.id inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfga.id = pcv.custom_field_group_assignment_id inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = cfga.custom_field_group_id inner join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cfg.object_type_id inner join flow.company_data_type cdt on cdt.id = cf.company_data_type_id where p.id = :projectId and ot.company_id = :companyId and ot.object_code = 'PROJECT' and cfga.archived is false order by cfga.field_order;
sql.project.getProcessStepsByProjectId: select p.id, ps.process_step_name, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as owner, coalesce(pps.date_modified, pps.date_created) as last_updated, p.company_process_id, pps.process_step_status_type_id, psst.process_step_status_type from flow.project p inner join flow.project_process_step pps on pps.project_id = p.id inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = pps.process_step_id inner join flow.process_step_status_type psst on psst.id = pps.process_step_status_type_id inner join flow.user_position up on up.id = pps.user_position_id inner join flow.user u on u.id = up.user_id where p.id = :projectId;
